_stamp: CONSTRUCTED -- there is no data/ directory on a fresh clone, so every value in this file stands in for state the running app holds. The LEAGUE ROWS are not from here: they come from ui_explore/seats/seat*.json, which are real composed claim bands.
_providers_note: This file names NO provider (#348). Identities, labels and credential names are read from the providers registry at build time. All this carries is which credentials happen to be set, which is a property of the environment rather than of the registry -- so registering kimi-k2 or grok adds a row here with no edit to the fixture or the builder.
